# Pull request

## Change

Describe the behavior changed and why.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran `bun run ci`, or explained why a narrower check is sufficient.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I did not weaken a threshold, suppress a finding, or skip a check without an explanation.
- [ ] I reviewed generated quality and security reports when relevant.

## Deployment

Deployment is currently out of scope. Note any future runtime or adapter requirement here.
